label: Puck Possession
description: Shows puck possession time by zone, including time with puck in the offensive, neutral, and defensive zone.

label: Scoring Chances
description: Shows shots or scoring chances created off the rush, cycle, forecheck, OZ play, and second-chance shots from the slot.  It also shows offensive generating plays and possession driving plays and puck possession time in seconds.

label: All Shots
description: Shows all shots taken from different locations in the offensive zone.

label: Inner Slot Shots
description: Shows shots, one-timers, and goals from the inner slot, with or without pressure.

label: Slot Shots
description: Shows shots, misses, blocks, one-timers, and goals from the slot.

label: Outside Shots
description: Shows shots, misses, blocks, one-timers, and goals from outside the slot.

label: Screened Shots
description: Shows shots, rebounds, goals, and true shooting percentage from different locations within the offensive zone.

label: Scoring
description: Shows goals scored and true shooting percentage. Expected goals shows expected goals created and actual to expected goals scored.

label: Total
description: Shows successful, failed, and success percentage for passing in the OZ, NZ, and DZ.

label: OZ Passes
description: Shows passing success, failure, success percentage, and passing tendency in the offensive zone.

label: DZ Passes
description: Shows passing success, failure, success percentage, and passing tendency in the defensive zone.

label: NZ Passes
description: Shows passing success, failure, success percentage, and passing tendency in the neutral zone.

label: Receptions
description: Shows passes received by zone, including in the DZ, NZ, OZ, and inside slot or outside of the slot.

label: All Exits
description: Shows controlled exits by type, dump-in recoveries, dump-outs, and icings.

label: By Opp Dump-In Types
description: Shows defensive zone exit success, failure, and success percentage for dump-in recovery types with and without pressure.

label: Controlled Entries
description: Shows OZ entry success, failure, and success percentage by controlled entry type.

label: All Dump-Ins
description: Shows dump-ins and recovery success, failure, and success percentage by dump-in type.

label: Dump-In Types
description: Shows dump-ins, recoveries, dump-ins that led to a shot, and dump-ins that led to a scoring chance, by dump-in type.

label: Regroups
description: Shows total regroups off of flip dump-out LPRs, including success rate of controlled entries and dump-in recoveries.

label: Open Ice Dekes
description: Shows open ice dekes attempts by zone.

label: Loose Puck Recoveries
description: Shows LPRs by zone, including LPRs after a shot, rebound, and contested LPRs.

label: All Face-Offs
description: Shows offensive and defensive zone face-offs taken, won, and face-offs leading to a shot on net or a scoring chance.

label: All Defensive Plays
description: Shows defensive plays by zone, including entry denials and entry denial success percentage.

label: DZ Denials
description: Shows defensive zone entry denial success, failure, and success percentage, including gap distance, and zone entries against leading to controlled exits or uncontrolled exits, and cycles, shots on goal, and scoring chances against.

label: DZ Denials - WOI
description: Shows all on-ice defensive zone entry denial success, failure, and success percentage, including gap distance, and zone entries against leading to controlled or uncontrolled exits, and cycles, shots on goal, and scoring chances against.

label: Body Checks
description: Shows body checks by zone.

label: Stick Checks
description: Shows stick checks by zone.

label: Blocks
description: Shows blocked shots, blocked passes in the offensive zone, blue line holds and reception preventions.

label: Possession Success Rate
description: Shows possession success rate and turnovers by zone.

label: All Plays
description: Shows goals scored for and against, shots attempts, passes to the slot, and defensive zone rebound recovery success rate while on ice.

label: All Penalties
description: Shows penalties taken by zone.

label: All Shootouts
description: Shows total attempts, shots on net, misses, failed dekes, and goals in the shootout.

label: Shot Aim
description: Shows the shot location for shootout attempts.

label: Shot Types
description: Shows the shot type for shootout attempts.
